description: Read a sending domain's separate DNS verification and sending readiness. Use verify_sending_domain to run a fresh check. dnsUpgrade.status: available (see upgrade_sending_domain_dns), in_progress (records to add), completed (oldRecords to delete) or unavailable. Receiving mail (inbox addresses and replies) is set up on receiving domains instead: see list_receiving_domains.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: check_website

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `check_website` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

ready.description: Whether the sender website is ready.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

website.description: The sending domain with separate DNS verification and readyToSend sending readiness; readiness.reason explains a domain that cannot send yet. inbound* fields in dnsRecords describe an older reply setup; receiving is managed with receiving domains. record returned by Sequenzy.
